reading: Some companies use drones, or flying machines, to bring orders to people's homes.
These deliveries are becoming part of everyday life for many people in the US.
Ashley Schmidt lives near Dallas and spends less time in her garden now.
She does not like the noise from delivery drones above her home.
She can hear them even inside her home.
Companies are looking for ways to make drones quieter.
Greenjets puts the parts that turn inside a cover to make less noise.
Wing changes where its drones fly to avoid flying over the same homes again and again.

vocabulary.definition: Things that people buy and ask a shop to send.
Times when someone brings things to a person or place.
An area outside a home where people grow flowers or other plants.
A sound, often one that people do not like.
In a building or place, not outside it.

entries.ja: 人が買って、店に送ってもらうよう頼む品物。
entries.ko: 사람들이 사고 가게에 보내 달라고 요청하는 물건들.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们购买并要求商店寄送的东西。
entries.es: Cosas que las personas compran y piden a una tienda que les envíe.
entries.pt-BR: Coisas que as pessoas compram e pedem a uma loja que envie.
entries.fr: Choses que les gens achètent et demandent à un magasin de leur envoyer.
entries.de: Dinge, die Menschen kaufen und die sie sich von einem Geschäft schicken lassen möchten.

entries.ja: 誰かが人や場所に物を届けること。
entries.ko: 누군가가 사람이나 장소에 물건을 가져다주는 일들.
entries.zh-Hans: 某人把东西送到一个人手中或某个地方的事。
entries.es: Ocasiones en las que alguien lleva cosas a una persona o a un lugar.
entries.pt-BR: Ocasiões em que alguém leva coisas a uma pessoa ou a um lugar.
entries.fr: Occasions où quelqu’un apporte des choses à une personne ou à un endroit.
entries.de: Vorgänge, bei denen jemand Dinge zu einer Person oder an einen Ort bringt.

entries.ja: 家の外にある、花やほかの植物を育てる場所。
entries.ko: 집 밖에서 사람들이 꽃이나 다른 식물을 기르는 공간.
entries.zh-Hans: 住宅外面供人们种植花卉或其他植物的一片地方。
entries.es: Un espacio fuera de una vivienda donde las personas cultivan flores u otras plantas.
entries.pt-BR: Uma área fora de uma casa onde as pessoas cultivam flores ou outras plantas.
entries.fr: Un espace à l’extérieur d’une habitation où les gens cultivent des fleurs ou d’autres plantes.
entries.de: Ein Bereich außerhalb eines Hauses, in dem Menschen Blumen oder andere Pflanzen anbauen.

entries.ja: 音のこと。人が不快に感じる音を指すことが多い。
entries.ko: 소리로, 흔히 사람들이 좋아하지 않는 소리.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种声音，通常是人们不喜欢的声音。
entries.es: Un sonido, a menudo uno que a las personas no les gusta.
entries.pt-BR: Um som, muitas vezes desagradável para as pessoas.
entries.fr: Un son, souvent désagréable pour les gens.
entries.de: Ein Geräusch, das Menschen oft als unangenehm empfinden.

entries.ja: 建物や場所の外ではなく、中に。
entries.ko: 건물이나 어떤 장소의 바깥이 아니라 안에.
entries.zh-Hans: 在建筑物或某个地方的内部，而不是外部。
entries.es: En el interior de un edificio o lugar, no fuera de él.
entries.pt-BR: Na parte de dentro de um prédio ou lugar, e não fora dele.
entries.fr: À l’intérieur d’un bâtiment ou d’un lieu, et non à l’extérieur.
entries.de: Im Inneren eines Gebäudes oder eines Ortes, nicht außerhalb davon.
